quote: If you took the points, you're in the wrong pool. Straight up only, baby!
A champion eats steak on Tuesday; the rest of you can split the leftover cold pizza. Next week's sheets hit the wire on Wednesday—don't be late!

Back in 1986, we'd wait until Tuesday morning for the paper to print the final box scores before tallying the official standings by hand. Monday Night Football has broken more hearts than bad blind dates—hold your horses until the final gun!
My strike zone wasn't small—your swing was just late. Pick your games on time and don't ask for an extension after kickoff.
Bunching up atop the leaderboard! Great competition across the crew—Winners Walk, Losers Stalk!
